segments.mil3.7.6:1.1: Rājā āha “kati nu kho, bhante nāgasena, bojjhaṅgā”ti?
segments.mil3.7.6:1.6: “Atha kissa nu kho, bhante, vuccanti ‘satta bojjhaṅgā’”ti?
segments.mil3.7.6:1.7: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, asi kosiyā pakkhitto aggahito hatthena ussahati chejjaṃ chinditun”ti.
segments.mil3.7.6:1.9: “Evameva kho, mahārāja, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgena vinā chahi bojjhaṅgehi na bujjhatī”ti.
